# gtme plan

Resolve adapters, validate every step's needs/uses and credentials, print the plan — no network, no spend; --viz appends a diagram of the resolved plan to the listing and --viz-only prints it alone (ADR-051), both renderings of the same plan and neither changing what plan accepts or exits with.

## Forms

```
gtme plan pipeline.yaml [--viz|--viz-only]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--viz` | nothing | --viz appends a diagram of the resolved plan to the listing and --viz-only prints it alone (ADR-051), both renderings of the same plan and neither changing what plan accepts or exits with. |
| `--viz-only` | nothing | --viz appends a diagram of the resolved plan to the listing and --viz-only prints it alone (ADR-051), both renderings of the same plan and neither changing what plan accepts or exits with. |

## Exit codes

| Code | Means |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | other error |
| 2 | validation or contract error: the plan, the file, or a value was refused |
| 3 | auth or credential error |
| 4 | rate-limited by a vendor |
| 5 | network error |

## Example

From [Your CSV](/start/my-csv):

```sh
gtme plan my-csv.yaml
```
